jobs.title: Director of Product, Ecosystem
jobs.description:
SambaNova is a leader in next-generation AI infrastructure, delivering a full-stack inference platform for customers worldwide. At the core of SambaNova's technology is the RDU (Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit) — a chip built on a dataflow architecture rather than the traditional GPU model. Its decode performance is especially strong for agentic workloads like multi-turn agents, code generation, and long-running applications. RDUs are packaged into SambaRack, rack-scale hardware that lets customers deploy state-of-the-art models with better performance, greater energy efficiency, and faster time to value.

SambaNova is a leader in next-generation AI infrastructure, delivering a full-stack inference platform for enterprises, AI labs, service providers, neo-clouds, and sovereign AI initiatives worldwide. SambaStack combines rack-scale hardware, optimized open-source models, and a serving platform to enable customers to deploy state-of-the-art models with superior performance, lower total cost of ownership, and rapid time to value. Built on SambaNova’s Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit (RDU), its dataflow architecture delivers low-latency, high-throughput inference on large models, with industry-leading decode performance that is especially impactful for agentic workloads such as multi-turn agents, code generation, and long-running applications.

Responsibilities

SambaNova is hiring a Director of Product, Ecosystem to shape ecosystem strategy for our core products across scale-out networking, inference serving, storage and caching, prefill compute, agentic CPU offload, and compiler and RDU research: defining which integrations to pursue, how we position them, and how partners deploy them. Customers deploy RDU in token factories alongside other vendors' hardware and software. This role will define how RDU fits across the stack, drive the reference architectures and certifications that partners build on, and turn those integrations into customer demand. It’s an opportunity to shape how SambaNova fits into the broader AI infrastructure ecosystem and set the partner strategy that domain product managers and engineering teams execute against. This individual will be responsible for:

Ecosystem strategy

- Define where RDU integrates into each customer segment's token factory: prefill compute, caching storage, scale-out networking, and agentic CPU offload alongside RDU decode.

- Make explicit build, partner, or ignore decisions for each integration area, write down the reasoning, and revisit it quarterly.

- Anchor positioning on decode economics: tokens per second per user, cost per million tokens, and latency tiers.

- Maintain a versioned ecosystem map with a changelog.

Partner enablement

- Publish joint reference architectures for each integration area, with defined integration points next to RDU decode.

- Own certification of RDU against the common cloud-native stack: Kubernetes, Prometheus, Grafana, and managed-stack vendors.

- Ship operators, metrics exporters, dashboards, and integration documentation as maintained products rather than one-off deliverables.

- Treat enablement as complete only when a cloud provider or partner can deploy from the reference architecture without SambaNova engineering support.

Core software ecosystem

- Secure and deliver co-optimization work with inference-engine builders (vLLM, SGLang, llm-d) and system-software optimizers so their runtimes run efficiently on RDU.

- Represent SambaNova in PyTorch and MLIR community work.

- Connect SambaNova's compiler and RDU research to the external ecosystem so programmability improvements reach the frameworks and toolchains partners build on.

- Support co-engineering with model partners so flagship open models run fastest on RDU.

Demand conversion

- Run joint go-to-market with token-factory partners where the buyer and the data center are shared.

- Own the analyst relationships with Marketing: supply benchmark data to SemiAnalysis and Artificial Analysis and co-develop token-factory reference guidance so buyers' TCO models reflect RDU's decode advantage.

- Feed partner and integration signal into product bets and competitive intelligence, in partnership with the Product Strategy and Competitive Intelligence lead.

Positioning and education

- Own external positioning for the core product surface: how networking, serving, storage, prefill, and offload fit together in a token factory.

- Produce internal educational content on the ecosystem for SambaNova teams.

- Deliver a quarterly ecosystem scorecard to the executive team: partner deployments, reference architectures shipped, benchmark results, and partner-attached pipeline.

How We Measure This Role

We measure this role by partner deployments and partner-attached pipeline. MOUs, press releases, and announced logos do not count until the partner has deployed.

Basic Qualifications

- 10+ years in AI infrastructure, accelerators, or data center systems, including 8+ years in product management with direct ownership of ecosystem, platform, or partner-facing product.

- Shipped partner-facing product artifacts (reference architectures, certification programs, or integration surfaces) that external teams adopted.

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.

Additional Required Qualifications

- Working fluency across scale-out networking, inference serving, storage and caching, prefill and decode disaggregation, CPU offload, and compiler toolchains, with depth in at least two.

- Track record of converting partnerships into measurable deployments, demand, or revenue.

- Fluency in inference economics: cost per million tokens, tokens per second per user, and latency and throughput tradeoffs by workload.

- Comfortable owning a strategy that other organizations execute. Technical depth in both network fabric topologies and inference serving stacks.

- Concise, quantified written communication for executive audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience at both a silicon or systems vendor (for example, the CUDA, ROCm, or oneAPI ecosystems, or an inference accelerator startup) and at a model lab or inference provider.

- Has closed and delivered at least one co-optimization engagement with a model provider.

- Contributions to, or close working relationships with, the vLLM, SGLang, llm-d, PyTorch, or MLIR communities.

- Exposure to hardware sales cycles: racks, data center constraints (power, cooling, density), and financing-backed deals.

- Has run joint go-to-market with networking, storage, or compute vendors that share a common buyer.

jobs.description:
SambaNova is a leader in next-generation AI infrastructure, delivering a full-stack inference platform for customers worldwide. At the core of SambaNova's technology is the RDU (Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit) — a chip built on a dataflow architecture rather than the traditional GPU model. Its decode performance is especially strong for agentic workloads like multi-turn agents, code generation, and long-running applications. RDUs are packaged into SambaRack, rack-scale hardware that lets customers deploy state-of-the-art models with better performance, greater energy efficiency, and faster time to value.

SambaNova is a leader in next-generation AI infrastructure, delivering a full-stack inference platform for enterprises, AI labs, service providers, neo-clouds, and sovereign AI initiatives worldwide. SambaStack combines rack-scale hardware, optimized open-source models, and a serving platform to enable customers to deploy state-of-the-art models with superior performance, lower total cost of ownership, and rapid time to value. Built on SambaNova’s Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit (RDU), its dataflow architecture delivers low-latency, high-throughput inference on large models, with industry-leading decode performance that is especially impactful for agentic workloads such as multi-turn agents, code generation, and long-running applications.

Responsibilities

SambaNova is hiring a Principal Product Manager, Product Strategy and Competitive Intelligence to turn market intelligence into decisions that shape our product and business. The role translates third-party research, competitor disclosures, and benchmark data into roadmap, pricing, and positioning decisions, while building AI-powered tooling to make that intelligence faster, deeper, and more scalable. The ideal candidate can build a TCO model from primary inputs, connect architecture specifications to financial performance, and go hands-on with AI tools to automate and continuously improve their own research pipeline.  This individual will be responsible for:

Market intelligence to product inputs

- Own the pipeline from third-party research (SemiAnalysis TCO, Tokenomics, Accelerator, and Datacenter models; competitor disclosures; benchmark data) to decision-ready analysis.

- Maintain the house model of where RDU inference wins on cost per million tokens, at which latency tiers, for which workloads, and against which competitor configurations.

- Convert TCO, tokenomics, and data center data into roadmap language: feature priorities, pricing moves, and segment bets.

- Open each product review with a summary of market changes since the last quarter and their implications for SambaNova.

Competitor specifications and roadmaps

- Track chip-level specifications for NVIDIA, AMD, Google TPU, AWS Trainium, Cerebras, Groq, and emerging accelerators: compute, memory hierarchy (SRAM, HBM, DDR), interconnect, power, process node, and packaging.

- Track rack- and cluster-level design: scale-up and scale-out topology, networking (NVLink-class fabrics, Ethernet and InfiniBand, optics), storage, cooling, and rack power density.

- Track roadmaps: announced parts, credible leaks, and supply signals such as HBM allocation, CoWoS capacity, and foundry node ramps.

- When a spec or roadmap change moves the TCO or latency frontier, quantify the effect on SambaNova's positioning within a week.

- Maintain a versioned spec comparison matrix with a changelog.

AI tooling for intelligence

- Build agentic pipelines that monitor research releases, competitor announcements, InferenceMAX and ClusterMAX updates, conference disclosures (Hot Chips, GTC, OCP), and regulatory and supply-chain filings.

- Extract specs and claims into the comparison matrix automatically, with human review on anything that feeds a decision.

- Automate the first draft of the weekly brief from monitored sources.

- Treat the tooling as a product and iterate on precision, coverage, and detection latency.

Segment and demand theses

- Use data center capacity and power data to pressure-test the SambaManaged pipeline: which operators have stranded power and cooling suited to air-cooled RDU racks, where, and on what timeline.

- Track workload mix shifts (agentic, chat, coding) and what they imply for decode-optimized positioning.

- Keep a short list of falsifiable house theses and score them quarterly against outcomes.

Intelligence cadence

- Write a weekly two-page brief covering what changed, what it means, and which decision is needed from whom.

- Produce a monthly deep dive tied to one live roadmap question.

- Run a quarterly thesis review with the product and executive teams.

- Set the analytical agenda for SambaNova's external research relationships, including the questions to raise on analyst calls and the custom data pulls to request. Another team member manages the vendor relationships and access. This role sets the questions and turns the outputs into product inputs.

How We Measure This Role

We measure this role by the product, pricing, and investment decisions its analysis changes, not by the volume of reports or summaries produced. Automated tooling handles monitoring and first drafts. The person in this role is accountable for the conclusions SambaNova draws from them.

Basic Qualifications

- 8+ years in semiconductor or AI infrastructure analysis, competitive intelligence, equity research, corporate or product strategy at a chip, cloud, or AI infrastructure company.

- Has built quantitative market or economic models (accelerator forecasts, TCO, capacity and demand) from primary inputs.

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, economics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience.

Additional Required Qualifications

- Fluent in accelerator and system architecture (compute, memory hierarchy, interconnect, power) and how each drives inference performance and cost.

- Track record of translating competitor spec and roadmap changes into product, pricing, or investment decisions.

- Hands-on with Python and LLM APIs, and able to build or direct agentic research tooling (extraction pipelines, monitoring agents) without waiting on an engineering team.

- Concise, quantified, executive-ready writing with stated uncertainty.

Preferred Qualifications

- Direct experience with SemiAnalysis models (TCO, Tokenomics, Accelerator, ClusterMAX, InferenceMAX) or comparable institutional research.

- Depth in inference economics: cost per million tokens, latency and throughput tradeoffs, prefill and decode disaggregation, and workload mix.

- Rack- and cluster-level fluency: networking, optics, cooling, power density, and scale-up and scale-out topologies.

- Has done capacity planning or GPU economics at a cloud, neocloud, or hyperscaler.

- Has written an investment thesis that redirected a roadmap or a capital allocation, or built a decision framework that others kept running.

- Willing to challenge a senior stakeholder's figures when the evidence supports it.

jobs.title: Principal Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
SambaNova is a leader in next-generation AI infrastructure, delivering a full-stack inference platform for customers worldwide. At the core of SambaNova's technology is the RDU (Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit) — a chip built on a dataflow architecture rather than the traditional GPU model. Its decode performance is especially strong for agentic workloads like multi-turn agents, code generation, and long-running applications. RDUs are packaged into SambaRack, rack-scale hardware that lets customers deploy state-of-the-art models with better performance, greater energy efficiency, and faster time to value.

SambaNova is hiring a Principal Product Marketing Manager to lead product positioning, portfolio strategy, and sales enablement for SambaRack and SambaStack. This role will define how SambaNova presents its purpose-built AI infrastructure to the market, translate product differentiation into clear customer value, and equip the field with the narratives and tools needed to win.

About the Role

This is a principal-level product marketing role for an experienced strategist and hands-on creator who can move from market insight to a crisp product narrative, and from that narrative to the launches, messaging, presentations, one-pagers, competitive guidance, and training used across the go-to-market organization. You will own the market-facing strategy for SambaRack—the turnkey, rack-level system built around SambaNova RDUs for large-scale AI inference—and SambaStack—the full-stack enterprise AI platform that combines hardware and software for deployments on premises or through dedicated cloud hosting.

You will partner closely with Technical Product Marketing, Account Executives, and Field Marketing to turn technical proof, customer needs, and field insight into differentiated product messaging and scalable go-to-market execution. Technical Product Marketing will contribute deployment-oriented technical content and demonstrations, while you will own product and portfolio positioning, audience and use-case strategy, launch narratives, competitive differentiation, sales enablement, and consistent market execution.

Responsibilities

- Own positioning, messaging, value propositions, personas, priority use cases, packaging narratives, and competitive differentiation for SambaRack and SambaStack

- Define the portfolio story that connects purpose-built RDU hardware, rack-level infrastructure, full-stack software, model serving, and deployment flexibility into a clear customer value proposition

- Build differentiated messaging for enterprise AI teams, infrastructure leaders, data center operators, inference providers, sovereign AI initiatives, technical evaluators, partners, and the field

- Lead go-to-market strategy and launch planning for major SambaRack and SambaStack capabilities, working across Product, Engineering, Sales, Communications, Developer Relations, Partner Marketing, and Design

- Develop high-quality sales enablement, including pitch decks, solution presentations, one-pagers, battlecards, discovery guidance, objection handling, competitive plays, and executive-ready content

- Create market-facing content such as product briefs, web copy, launch assets, blogs, customer presentations, thought leadership, and solution narratives

- Partner with Technical Product Marketing to translate deployment experience, technical proof, and demonstrations into sharper positioning and more useful seller guidance

- Work with Account Executives and Field Marketing to refine product messaging around customer needs, activate it through field and regional programs, and build scalable enablement for customer conversations

- Equip sales, solutions, partners, and customer-facing teams with repeatable training and content; measure adoption and improve materials based on field feedback

- Lead market, customer, and competitive research to identify emerging needs, sharpen differentiation, inform roadmap discussions, and improve go-to-market priorities

- Build customer proof points, references, use cases, and stories that make SambaRack and SambaStack value concrete

- Establish messaging governance and reusable frameworks that keep product, sales, web, campaign, partner, developer, and executive narratives aligned

- Define success metrics for launches, enablement adoption, message pull-through, content usage, field readiness, and business impact

What We’re Looking For

- 10+ years of experience in B2B product marketing, product strategy, technical product marketing, or a closely related role, including ownership of complex enterprise technology portfolios

- Deep fluency in AI infrastructure, enterprise AI, semiconductors, data center systems, cloud platforms, or another technically complex market

- A track record of creating differentiated positioning for integrated hardware-software products and translating it into launches, sales enablement, content, and measurable go-to-market outcomes

- Exceptional writing, editing, presentation, and narrative-development skills across executive, business, field, and technical audiences

- Strong strategic judgment paired with a willingness to build the deck, write the one-pager, develop the battlecard, edit the web page, and deliver the training

- Experience influencing executive leaders and coordinating Product, Engineering, Technical Product Marketing, Account Executives, Field Marketing, Communications, Design, and partner stakeholders without direct authority

- Ability to operate independently, prioritize high-leverage work, and bring structure to ambiguity in a fast-moving environment

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience marketing AI inference platforms, accelerator systems, turnkey data center products, full-stack enterprise platforms, or cloud infrastructure

- Experience developing product and portfolio strategy across related hardware and software offerings

- Experience building a sales enablement program with measurable adoption, field readiness, and business impact

- Familiarity with enterprise buyers, infrastructure decision-makers, technical evaluators, inference providers, partner ecosystems, and managed-service use cases

- Experience leading category creation, a major product launch, competitive repositioning, or a portfolio-wide messaging transformation

- A portfolio of high-quality positioning, launch, enablement, thought-leadership, or product-marketing work

Why This Role Matters

SambaRack and SambaStack give SambaNova a differentiated product story spanning purpose-built hardware and a full-stack enterprise AI platform. This role will make that story clear, consistent, and commercially useful—shaping how the market understands the portfolio and giving sellers and partners the positioning and tools they need to create demand and win.
